WHERE 1=1
AND va.plan_id = #{query.planId}
AND pp.plan_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.planCode}, '%')
SELECT pp.id as plan_id, pp.plan_code, pp.plan_start_time, pp.plan_end_time, pa.id as assignment_id, pa.pilot_id as resource_id, 'PILOT' as resource_type, p.pilot_name as resource_name, p.pilot_code as resource_code, p.phone as resource_phone, p.on_duty_status as resource_status, pa.role_type as assignment_type, pa.estimated_start_time, pa.estimated_end_time, pa.status as assignment_status, pa.created_at as assignment_created_at, NULL as confirmation_id, NULL as confirm_method, NULL as confirmation_status, NULL as confirmed_by, NULL as confirmed_at, NULL as confirmation_notes, NULL as confirmed_by_name, v.name_zh as vessel_name, v.name_en as vessel_name_en, v.vessel_call_sign, voy.voyage_number, voy.voyage_type, NULL as license_plate, NULL as vehicle_model, NULL as call_sign, NULL as purpose, NULL as task_type FROM plan_pilot_assignments pa INNER JOIN pilotage_plans pp ON pa.plan_id = pp.id INNER JOIN pilots p ON pa.pilot_id = p.id LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id WHERE 1=1
AND pa.plan_id = #{query.planId}
AND pp.plan_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.planCode}, '%')
UNION ALL
SELECT pp.id as plan_id, pp.plan_code, pp.plan_start_time, pp.plan_end_time, da.id as assignment_id, da.driver_id as resource_id, 'DRIVER' as resource_type, d.name as resource_name, d.driver_code as resource_code, d.phone as resource_phone, d.on_duty_status as resource_status, da.task_type as assignment_type, da.estimated_start_time, da.estimated_end_time, da.status as assignment_status, da.created_at as assignment_created_at, NULL as confirmation_id, NULL as confirm_method, NULL as confirmation_status, NULL as confirmed_by, NULL as confirmed_at, NULL as confirmation_notes, NULL as confirmed_by_name, v.name_zh as vessel_name, v.name_en as vessel_name_en, v.vessel_call_sign, voy.voyage_number, voy.voyage_type, veh.license_plate, veh.vehicle_model, NULL as call_sign, NULL as purpose, da.task_type FROM plan_driver_assignments da INNER JOIN pilotage_plans pp ON da.plan_id = pp.id INNER JOIN drivers d ON da.driver_id = d.id LEFT JOIN vehicles veh ON d.vehicle_id = veh.id LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id WHERE 1=1
AND da.plan_id = #{query.planId}
AND pp.plan_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.planCode}, '%')
UNION ALL
SELECT pp.id as plan_id, pp.plan_code, pp.plan_start_time, pp.plan_end_time, ta.id as assignment_id, ta.tugboat_id as resource_id, 'TUGBOAT' as resource_type, t.tugboat_name as resource_name, t.tugboat_code as resource_code, NULL as resource_phone, t.status as resource_status, ta.assignment_type, ta.estimated_start_time, ta.estimated_end_time, ta.status as assignment_status, ta.created_at as assignment_created_at, NULL as confirmation_id, NULL as confirm_method, NULL as confirmation_status, NULL as confirmed_by, NULL as confirmed_at, NULL as confirmation_notes, NULL as confirmed_by_name, v.name_zh as vessel_name, v.name_en as vessel_name_en, v.vessel_call_sign, voy.voyage_number, voy.voyage_type, NULL as license_plate, NULL as vehicle_model, t.call_sign, ta.assignment_type as purpose, NULL as task_type FROM plan_tugboat_assignments ta INNER JOIN pilotage_plans pp ON ta.plan_id = pp.id INNER JOIN tugboats t ON ta.tugboat_id = t.id LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id WHERE 1=1
AND ta.plan_id = #{query.planId}
AND pp.plan_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.planCode}, '%')
UNION ALL
SELECT pp.id as plan_id, pp.plan_code, pp.plan_start_time, pp.plan_end_time, pba.id as assignment_id, pba.pilot_boat_id as resource_id, 'PILOT_BOAT' as resource_type, pb.boat_name as resource_name, pb.vessel_call_sign as resource_code, NULL as resource_phone, pb.current_status as resource_status, pba.purpose as assignment_type, pba.estimated_start_time, pba.estimated_end_time, pba.status as assignment_status, pba.created_at as assignment_created_at, NULL as confirmation_id, NULL as confirm_method, NULL as confirmation_status, NULL as confirmed_by, NULL as confirmed_at, NULL as confirmation_notes, NULL as confirmed_by_name, v.name_zh as vessel_name, v.name_en as vessel_name_en, v.vessel_call_sign, voy.voyage_number, voy.voyage_type, NULL as license_plate, NULL as vehicle_model, pb.vessel_call_sign as call_sign, pba.purpose, NULL as task_type FROM plan_pilot_boat_assignments pba INNER JOIN pilotage_plans pp ON pba.plan_id = pp.id INNER JOIN pilot_boats pb ON pba.pilot_boat_id = pb.id LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id WHERE 1=1
AND pba.plan_id = #{query.planId}
AND pp.plan_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.planCode}, '%')
) combined_results
WHERE 1=1
AND DATE(COALESCE(confirmed_at, assignment_created_at)) >= DATE(#{query.startDate})
AND DATE(COALESCE(confirmed_at, assignment_created_at)) <= DATE(#{query.endDate})
AND confirm_method = #{query.confirmMethod}
AND confirmation_id IS NULL AND assignment_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND confirmation_status = #{query.confirmationStatus}

SELECT resource_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as confirmed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmation_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmation_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejected_count, SUM(CASE WHEN confirmation_status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancelled_count FROM plan_confirmations WHERE plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY resource_type

SELECT -- 计划信息 pp.id as plan_id, pp.plan_code, pp.plan_start_time, pp.plan_end_time, pp.plan_status,
-- 引航员分配信息 pa.id as assignment_id, pa.pilot_id as resource_id, 'PILOT' as resource_type, p.pilot_name as resource_name, p.pilot_code as resource_code, p.phone as resource_phone, p.on_duty_status as resource_status, pa.role_type as assignment_type, pa.estimated_start_time, pa.estimated_end_time, pa.status as assignment_status, pa.created_at as assignment_created_at,
-- 确认记录信息 pc.id as confirmation_id, pc.confirm_method, pc.confirmation_status, pc.confirmed_by, pc.confirmed_at, pc.notes as confirmation_notes,
-- 确认人信息 u.username as confirmed_by_name,
-- 船舶信息 v.name_zh as vessel_name, v.name_en as vessel_name_en, v.vessel_call_sign,
-- 航次信息 voy.voyage_number, voy.voyage_type,
-- 额外字段 NULL as license_plate, NULL as vehicle_model, NULL as call_sign, NULL as purpose, NULL as task_type
FROM plan_pilot_assignments pa INNER JOIN pilots p ON pa.pilot_id = p.id INNER JOIN pilotage_plans pp ON pa.plan_id = pp.id LEFT JOIN plan_confirmations pc ON pc.plan_id = pa.plan_id AND pc.resource_type = 'PILOT' AND pc.resource_id = pa.pilot_id LEFT JOIN users u ON pc.confirmed_by = u.id LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id WHERE pa.pilot_id = #{pilotId} AND pp.plan_status IN ('PUBLISHED','CONFIRMED','ONGOING','COMPLETED','CERTIFICATED','BILLED','PAID')
AND (pc.id IS NULL OR pc.confirmation_status != 'CONFIRMED') AND pa.status != 'CANCELLED'
AND pa.status = #{status}
ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

FROM plan_driver_assignments da INNER JOIN drivers d ON da.driver_id = d.id INNER JOIN pilotage_plans pp ON da.plan_id = pp.id LEFT JOIN plan_confirmations pc ON pc.plan_id = da.plan_id AND pc.resource_type = 'DRIVER' AND pc.resource_id = da.driver_id LEFT JOIN users u ON pc.confirmed_by = u.id LEFT JOIN vehicles veh ON d.vehicle_id = veh.id LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pp.vessel_id = v.id LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pp.voyage_id = voy.id WHERE da.driver_id = #{driverId} AND pp.plan_status IN ('PUBLISHED','CONFIRMED','ONGOING','COMPLETED','CERTIFICATED','BILLED','PAID')
